description: A black USB hub sits on the green bedsheet in front of a blue pillow, with a black cable draped across the bed. The left hand and right hand move in toward the hub; the left hand grips and pulls the USB plug straight up to remove it while the right hand steadies the hub as a right-hand object, then the left hand brings the plug back down and pushes it into a port while the right hand holds the hub in place before both hands let go.
